recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is for current core. No follow-up is needed in the current build; any retroactive R4 technical-correction publication would be a separate release process.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive OO issue requesting that the Glasgow Coma Scale Observation example replace the artificial local coding system http://acme.ec with http://example.org and add XML comments explaining that LOINC definitions already include scoring and can be combined with ordinalValue extensions.
initial_application: The linked terminology Zulip thread led to the tracker, and implementation commit 9c8960601b81da5873378ddc5c6b407d98c44da3 changed source/observation/observation-example-glasgow.xml to add the requested comment and replace the three local coding systems with http://example.org/codes. Merge commit 054442980c309487027a92a1a76c696419e4a988 brought PR #3178 to master.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, the Glasgow example is part of the Observation examples, and OO September 2024 WGM minutes record the FHIR-27758 motion as persuasive with 16 in favor. A Jira comment mentioned R4 if a technical correction is made, but this current-build core reconciliation does not require a separate R4 edit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source and combined branch already have the LOINC/ordinalValue explanatory comment and three http://example.org/codes systems, and no http://acme.ec or http://acme.ce reference remains in the Glasgow XML.
